key.description: Generic issue-tracker ticket-key shape (project-prefix + number); the prefix itself is an opaque value, never enumerated here. Works for any tracker (Jira, Linear, GitHub-style project keys, etc.).

status.description: Free-text tracker status as written in the source doc (may include a legend glyph, e.g. '✅ Done', '🔄 In Progress', '📋 To Do', '⛔ Blocked', '❌ Cancelled', or a plain word like 'Active'/'Analyse'). Not a closed enum — trackers add new statuses over time, and status vocabularies differ across tools.

spec_coverage.description: Free-text pointer back into the spec (e.g. a User Story id and title, a cross-epic arrow, 'Meta: ...', or 'N/A' with a reason) — not a structured ref list.

feature_or_scope.description: Title / scope of this cross-spec tracking document.

legend.description: Optional restatement of the status-glyph legend used in the source doc, as opaque strings.

epic_key.description: Omitted when the source doc marks the epic as having no tracker key yet (e.g. '(No epic)').

spec_ref.description: Link/path to the epic's own spec file, as an opaque string.

discovered_tickets.description: Tickets found during sync that weren't part of the original epic search.

gaps.description: Tickets that exist but currently lack (or only loosely propose) spec coverage.

missing_tickets.description: Spec-side requirements that have no tracker ticket yet.

proposed_ticket.description: Free-text note on what ticket should be created, if stated.
